name: GeedoProductFinder
description: The crawler for Geedo, a product-search engine specialised in online retail. The operator states it indexes products directly from online stores and distributes the results across roughly 200 regional Geedo sites based on the shop's location, currently covering over 8 billion products from more than 5 million stores, and that it limits itself to publicly accessible product pages while following robots.txt rules, rate limits and site-owner restrictions.
